tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: mi tra snying thig las: 'jig rten dbang phyug mchod pa'i thabs: bram ze'i lugs tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so: 1$0000250o rgyan yul gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i mchod tshul lo:1$0000300

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ : rgya gar skad du: ārya lo ki shwa ra pū tsa na ma: bod skad du: 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug mchod pa'i thabs: mgon po 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo: mi tra snying thig las: 'jig rten dbang phyug rtsa ba lha bcu drug gi mchod phreng 'di la don gsum ste: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum: sngon 'gro dang po bgegs bskrad pa: gnyis pa srung 'khor bsgom pa: gsum pa rang gi sgo gsum byin gyis brlab pa: bzhi pa rdor dril byin gyis brlab pa: lnga pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa'o: dngos gzhi la dang po gzhal yas khang bsgom pa: gnyis pa gdan bskyed pa: gsum pa lha bskyed pa: bzhi pa spyan 'dren pa: lnga pa mchod yon 'bul zhing bzhugs su gsol ba: drug pa phyag 'tshal ba: bdun pa mchod pa 'bul ba: brgyad pa bstod pa 'bul ba: dgu pa rgyal srid 'bul ba: bcu pa rdzogs mtha'i bstod pa: bcu gcig pa 'dzab bstod bya ba'o: sa ma ya: ྈྈྈ dang po gnas khang phyag bdar dang gu gul bdug: rdul tshon ras ris tshom bu gang rigs kyi dkyil 'khor bsham: de'i dbus su bum pa rdzas ldan bum rgyan legs par bstar la bsham: g.yon nas rim bzhin mchod yon: zhabs bsil: me tog: bdug spos: mar me: byug pa: bshos gtsang rnams rim pa ltar du bsham: gdugs dang: bla re: yol ba: dha dhi sogs bkod pa gang 'dzom dang: sku gsung thugs rten la sogs thams cad bshams la: rnal 'byor pa rang khrus kyis dag par byed: rab smyung gnas la gnas par byed nas gos gsar pa bgo: dkar gtor bgegs gtor bshams shing byin brlabs byas nas rang nyid skad cig gis khro bo rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa bskyed la: dbu yis rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa: rngog ma le brgan me dpung du 'bar bas me dang mtshon cha'i gur khang du 'khrigs pa'i dbal las gnod byed thal ba bun bun bsreg par

bsam la: hūm̐: chos sku rnam dag mtshan ma kun spangs kyang: thugs rje'i dbang gis gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir: shin tu mi bzad khro chen 'bar ba'i sku: yid bzhin sku mchog ston mdzad dbyings nas bzhengs: chos dbyings nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes nyi ma gsal ba'i skur bzhengs pa: rang rig 'dod pa'i dbang bsgyur rta mchog dpal: dbang chen 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa la gnas pa yi: lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig: rgyal ba'i pho brang gnyan po 'dir 'debs pas: dkar phyogs skyong ba'i srung ma dam tshig can: yul lha yul bdag dge bsnyen gtor ma bzhes: sa 'di stsol la dge ba'i stongs grogs gyis: bgegs rigs gdon gyi tshogs rnams ma lus pa: lan chags glud gtor khyer la phyir dengs shig: gal te mi 'gro 'dug par gyur na ni: khro rgyal dpa' bo chen po thugs khros nas: ye shes mtshon cha rab tu 'bar ba yis: mgo lus snying yang tshal par 'gas par 'gyur: oṃ badzra kro ta hya ghrī wa sarba bhig nān utstsha tya hūm̐ phaṭa: gnyis pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang drag khro bo'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer steng 'og phyogs bcur 'phros pa las: ye shes me dang mtshon cha'i tshwa tshwa 'bar: steng 'og phyogs mtshams khor yug gur khang 'khrigs: rlung yang rgyu ba'i skabs med rab tu gtams: oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: gsum pa sgo gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni: byin gyis brlabs pa'i chus gnas lngar reg cing gnas khang la 'thor zhing lhag ma btung la: rdo rje sems ni ye shes sems: byang chub sems ni bla na med: rdo rje'i chu ni dri ma bral: snod bcud rnam par dag par gyur: oṃ shuddhe bhi shuddhe swā hā: zhes lus byin brlab: bdag nyid gsung gi dbang phyug che: padma'i ljags ni yi ge hrī: 'dab brgyad rdo rje dbus la gnas: sgra grags 'gro kun chos sgrar gyur:

hrīḥbadzra dzī hā: zhes ljags rdo rje nyal thabs su bsam pa ni ngag byin brlab bo: lag dang bsgrang phreng byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: lag g.yas nyi ma g.yon zla ba: zla bar a la nyi mar hūm̐: thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin las: bde stong phreng ba lu gu rgyud: gzung gi rang bzhin 'od dpag med: hūm̐ ā: ma ṇi dha ra hūm̐: bzhi pa rdor dril byin brlab pa ni: hūm̐: rdo rje gsor ba mdzes pa ste: sems can thams cad rab bsgral phyir: rnam thar chos su byed pa yi: snying po mchog gi rdo rje gsor: oṃ ā ma hā badzra hūm̐: rdo rje la'o: dril bu la: ā: shes rab thabs kyi cho ga yis: 'gro ba rnams ni sad pa'i bdag: mi shes 'dam du bying ba yi: sems can don phyir dkrol bar bya: oṃ āḥdharma gaṇḍe ho: de nas rol mo kun la: ā li kā li mnyam sbyor bas: mnyam par bzhag pa hūm̐ gi lus: phyogs bcu kun tu dkrol byas te: shes rab thabs kyi sgra sgrog bya: oṃ āḥm hā dharmā ghaṇḍe hūm̐: lnga pa mchod pa byin brlab pa ni: bsang chu 'thor la: oṃ a mṛta kunḍa lī ha na ha na bi shuddhe swā hā: sngags kyi sgra las 'od byung bas: 'od zer 'bar ba'i bdud rtsi yis: dngos 'dzin dri ma 'bag btsog kun: dag par gyur cing stong pa'i ngang: sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam 'phrul las: zad med bcud rdzas mkha' mnyam gyur : oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra ghandhe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra nai widya āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐: zhes brjod do: spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la: dang po snod dag par bya phyir gzhal yas khang bsgom pa ni: āoṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: zhes brjod pas: chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bur stong par gyur: stong pa'i ngang las e las nam mkha' mthing nag:

chos 'byung ba'i dbyibs can: yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngo skya zla gam: baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po: laṃ las gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du bhrūm̐ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa gru bzhi bang rim bzhi sna tshogs rdo rjes bteg par bskyed: de'i lte bar bhrūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dbyibs gru bzhi: sgo bzhi: rta babs bzhis mtshan pa: dbus su lte ba dkar zhing zlum pa la padma dmar po 'dab ma drug dang ldan pa: de'i phyi rol bar khyams sgo bzhi par gsal ba: de'i phyi rim rin po che sna lnga'i rtsig pa la gser gyi pha gu'i kha bad kyis mdzes pa: mu tig gi drwa ba dang drwa phyed dang: chun po 'phyang ba la shar bu'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa: rmang gzhi'i phyi stegs la lha snam dmar po la 'dod yon gyi lha mo mang pos bskor ba: steng gi kha khyer la ba so'i mda' yab dang: sna tshogs dar khra'i skas kyis mdzes pa: phyogs bzhi'i sgo bzhi'i steng na: gser gyi ka bas g.yu'i gdung ma bteg pa'i rta babs cha bzhi padma 'khor lo dang gdugs kyis phub pa: phyi rol gyi khor yug la padma'i phreng ba dang: rdo rje'i ra ba dang: ye shes kyi me ris bskor ba: gzhal yas khang gi steng thams cad rin po che'i 'od kyi tshang khang bye ru dmar pos byas pa la shel ltar dwangs pa: de'i mtha' gzhol dbus mtho ba'i rtse mo rin po che dbang gi rgyal pos mtshan pa: gzhal yas khang de phyi nang med par gsal ba'i rgya khyon dpag tu med cing gzhal ba'i tshad las 'das pa: chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du bsgom par bya: gnyis pa gdan gsal ba ni: de'i dbus paṃ las sna tshogs padma'i sdong po 'dab ma stong du ldan pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya rgyas pa bskyed par bya'o: gsum pa bcud nyams pa dag par bya ba la: cho ga gsum las lha gsal ba ni: gdan gyi steng du rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdakar po gcig gsal:

de las 'od zer phyogs bcur dkar lam gyis 'phros pas sems can la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib rnams dag nas lha'i skur gyur: de thams cad tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim pas: hrīḥ'od du zhu ba las padma dkar po'i lte bar yi ge hrīḥyis mtshan pa gcig tu gyur: padma hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs nas padma hrīḥdang bcas pa la thim pas: de 'od du zhu ba las: bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba: g.yas kyi 'og ma na mu tig gi phreng ba 'dzin pa: g.yon gyi 'og ma na me tog padma dkar po bsnams pa: sku mdog gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar la 'tsher ba: spyan yid tsam dmar ba: zhal cung zad 'dzum pa: shangs kyi dbyibs mtho ba: snyan shal ring ba: sku drang por gnas shing zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa: dbu skra lcang lo'i thor tshugs 'khyil ba: spyi bo'i gtsug tu a mi dhe wa bzhugs pa: sku mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad kyis spras pa: rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa: dar dmar po'i smad g.yogs gsol ba: 'jig rten gsum la thugs rjes gzigs pa'i skur gsal la: de'i thugs ka nas thig le dkar po gcig g.yon du 'phros pas: yum yi ge drug ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma: phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba: g.yas kyi 'og ma na mu tig gi phreng ba 'dren pa: g.yon gyi 'og ma na padma dkar po bsnams pa: rin po che sna tshogs dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes par brgyan pa: zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis yab kyi zhal la gzigs pa: zhabs gnyis btsun mo'i rol stabs kyis padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam mo: yang gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od kyi thig le ser po gcig g.yas su 'phros pa las: sras nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa:

phyag g.yas kyi nor bu rin po che thugs kar 'dzin pa: g.yon pas padma be'u dpung pa'i zur du bsnams pa: rin po che sna tshogs dang dar gyi na bza' dang: zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis yab kyi thugs khar gzigs pa: zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i stabs kyis padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o: yang thugs ka nas 'od kyi thig le sngon po gcig mdun du 'phros pas: sras mo rig sngags 'dzin ma sku mdog sngon mo dar dang rin po che du mas brgyan pa phyag g.yas phreng ba dang g.yon utpal sngon po bsnams nas phyed skyil gyis padma dang zla ba'i steng du bzhugs pa'o: yang gtso bo'i thugs ka nas hrīḥbazhi 'phros pa las: shar du tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po phyag ni mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin pa'i pang du yum gos dkar mo tshe bum bsnams nas 'khril ba: lhor mi g.yo mgon po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri dang sdigs mdzub bsgrengs nas glang chen gyi steng du pus btsug gis bzhugs pa: nub tu 'khor ba dong sprugs sku mdog dmar po rgyan med gcer bur bzhengs pa phyag gnyis tshe bum thugs kar bsnams pa: byang du rigs drug spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig phyag nyi shu rtsa gnyis: rtsa phyag gnyis bum pa dang phreng ba 'dzin cing: g.yas bcus byang chub sems dpa' bcu: g.yon bcus sems ma bcu 'dzin cing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan par padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhengs thabs su bzhugs pa'o: mtshams bzhir rta mgrin dmar po dbyug to bsnams pa: rig byed ma dmar mo lcags kyu bsnams pa: dzambha la ser po ne'u le bsnams pa: mgon po nag po bing bsnams par bskyed do: padma 'dab ma drug la gsung chos nyid kyi rang sgra yi ge 'bru drug: mu khyud la thugs ye shes lnga'i 'od lnga 'ja' ris su 'khyil par bskyed: sgo bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi dang: grwa bzhir rin po che'i bum pa bzhi rnams gsal:

gzhan yang steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du rtsa brgyud bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems: mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad til gyi gong bu bzhin du them mer bzhugs par bsam la: gtso 'khor rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po: mgrin par āḥdamar po: thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po: thugs kyi padma la yi ge hrīḥyig gi tha ma la yi ge drug gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas: thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug gi lha tshogs thams cad byon par bsam mo: bzhi pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: thugs rje'i dbang gis ye shes sku bzhengs shig: kun gyi mgon mdzad lha yi lhar gyur pa'i: mgon po thugs rje chen po gshegs su gsol: zhing mchog bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas: nyon mongs rnam dag padma lta bu'i sku: 'jig rten kun la thugs rjes dbang bsgyur ba'i: bcom ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug gshegs su gsol: pho brang ri bo ta la'i rtse mo nas: thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs mdzad cing: sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa'i: 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gshegs su gsol: ma rig dbang gis 'gro ba'i sems can rnams: nyam thag 'jig rten gsum du 'khyams pa la: ye shes thugs rje mchog gis mgon mdzad pa'i: 'jig rten mgon po 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: oṃ e hye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ye hūm̐: sa ma ya st+waṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: lnga pa bzhugs su gsol zhing khrus chab 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bdud rtsi 'jam yang 'o ma'i rgya mtsho ste: dri med yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu: bcom ldan khyed la mchod yon 'di 'bul gyis: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka arghaṃ pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: khrus gsol: hūm̐: 'phags pa'i sku la dri ma mi mnga' yang: 'jig rten pa dang 'jug par mdzad pa'i phyir:

chu gtsang spos dang sbyar ba'i khrus chab 'dis: zhal dang phyag zhabs sku khrus gsol bar bgyi: 'gro kun las sgrib ma lus dag gyur cig: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pra wa ra sad ka ra pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: gdan 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bdag dang 'gro ba kun gyi don gyi phyir: 'ja' tshon bkod legs spel 'dra'i gzhal yas 'dir: padma zla ba mdzes pa'i gdan stengs su: bcom ldan dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ā be sha ya tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ye hūm̐: drug pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar: rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan can: thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs: spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs rje dang ni shes rab gnyis: thabs kyi sprul pas 'gro ba 'dren: yab yum sras bcas yang 'khor bcas: don mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo: 'od dpag med dang mi g.yo mgon: 'khor ba dong sprugs spyan ras gzigs: rta mgrin rig byed dzam bha la: mgon po rgyal po chen po bzhi: dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pu ru sha ya na mo hūm̐:

bdun pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus thams cad kyi: nyon mongs tsha gdung ma lus spang phyir dang: bsil ldan zhi gnas rgya mtsho 'thob bya'i phyir: bdag gis khyed la mchod yon 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka arghaṃ pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus thams cad kyi: glo bur dri ma ma lus spang phyir dang: dri med rnam dag ye shes thob bya'i phyir: bdag gis khyed la zhabs bsil 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pra wa ra sad ka ra pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus thams cad kyi: gzugs ngan zug rngu'i skyon rnams spang phyir dang: mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thob bya'i phyir: bdag gis khyed la me tog 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka puṣpe pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus thams cad kyi: 'chal ba'i dri ma ma lus spang phyir dang: zag med tshul khrims rnam dag thob bya'i phyir: bdag gis khyed la bdug spos 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dhū pe pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus thams cad kyi: gti mug ma rig mun pa spang phyir dang: 'od gsal ye shes snang ba thob bya'i phyir: bdag gis khyed la snang gsal 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ā lo ke pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus thams cad kyi: gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i dri ma spang phyir dang: mi rtog ting 'dzin dam pa thob bya'i phyir: bdag gis khyed la dri chab 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ghandhe pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus thams cad kyi: bkres skom log 'tsho'i zas ngan spang phyir dang: yid bzhin zas mchog dam pa thob bya'i phyir: bdag gis khyod la zhal zas 'bul bar bgyi:

oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka nai widya pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus thams cad kyi: ngan song 'khor ba'i gnas ngan spang phyir dang: zhing khams rnam par dag pa thob bya'i phyir: bdag gis khyed la maṇḍal 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka maṇḍa la pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐: mtha' yas sems can ma lus thams cad kyi: ngan 'gro log pa'i sgra ngan spang phyir dang: tshangs pa'i gsungs dbyangs snyan thob bya ba'i phyir: bdag gis khyed la sil snyan 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka shabda pū tsa me gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐: zhes 'bul: brgyad pa bstod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las: stong pa nyid dang snying rje dbyer med pas: nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i sku mnga' ba: thugs rje chen po khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser ltar lhang nge ba: sku yi gzi brjid nyi ma stong las lhag: rin chen gser gyi mchod sdong lta bu yi: 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa dpal brtsegs zhes: 'das pa'i dus nas mngon par sangs rgyas kyang: thugs rje'i dbang gis sa bcu'i tshul 'dzin pa'i: 'gro 'dul spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: stong nyid chos sgras 'jig rten lta ngan 'joms: ma rtogs log rtog the tshom bsal mdzad de: bdag med byang chub rdo rje'i lam ston pa: chos sgrag rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod: blo gros rab mchog dpag med bsam yas kyis: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las rol mdzad cing: shes bya ma lus mngon sum gzigs pa po: kun mkhyen ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mtshan gyi me tog rab tu rgyas pa la: dpe byad bzang po'i 'bras bu chags mdzes sku: gang gis mthong thos 'dod pa'i don rdzogs pa'i: mtshan gyi rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal bstod:

'gro ba rgyu drug 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor na: sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba'i sems can rnams: thugs rje'i thabs kyis myur du 'dren pa yi: thogs med mthu stobs ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod: sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir: 'jig rten khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang: chags pas ma gos padma ltar gnas pa'i: ye nas rnam dag khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: dgu pa nang du rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: yid 'ong dbyibs legs lte ba rab tu mdzes: mu khyud rtsibs stong 'khor lo rin chen 'di: 'gro kun srid pa'i sdug bsngal bcad bya'i phyir: bdag gis 'khor lo rin chen 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka tsakra ratna ye pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐: dgos 'dod rgya chen bde legs 'byung ba'i dpal: yon tan dpag med nor bu rin chen 'di: 'gro kun 'byor pa phun sum tshogs bya'i phyir: bdag gis nor bu rin chen 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ma ṇi ratna ye pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐: gzugs mdzes sgeg cing 'gyings ldan blta na sdug: shes rab rig ma btsun mo rin chen 'di: 'gro kun chos dbyings ye shes rtogs bya'i phyir: bdag gis btsun mo rin chen 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka warti ratna ye pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐: blo gros rab rgyas dran pa'i 'od zer 'gyed: sna tshogs sgyur mdzad blon po rin chen 'di: 'gro kun phrin las dpag med bsgrub bya'i phyir: bdag gis blon po rin chen 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka iṭṭa ra ye pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐: stobs chen lus rgyas go mtshon rgyan gyis brgyan: gdul dka'i dpung 'joms dmag dpon rin chen 'di: 'gro kun nyon mongs dgra rnams gzhom bya'i phyir: bdag gis dmag dpon rin chen 'bul bar bgyi:

oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dhu sha ratna ye pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐: lus che stobs rtsal mche ba rab tu rno: theg chen yangs pa'i glang po rin chen 'di: 'gro kun theg pa mchog gi don rtogs phyir: bdag gis glang po rin chen 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇ-i ka hasti ratna ye pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐: gzugs mdzes shugs drag mgyogs par 'gro ba yi: yid 'ong cang shes rta mchog rin chen 'di: 'gro kun sangs rgyas zhing du bgrod bya'i phyir: bdag gis rta mchog rin chen 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi kā gho ra ratna ye pra tītstsha sa ma ye hūm̐: bcu pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: gang gi byin rlabs 'od zer rab 'phros pas: bdag sogs rmongs pa ma lus thams cad kyi: snying gi mun pa ma lus sel mdzad pa: bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sku gsum bdag nyid mkhyen ldan bde bar gshegs: zhi ba chags bral dus gsum dam pa'i chos: lha mi'i mchod 'os tshogs mchog dge 'dun te: dkon mchog rin chen gsum la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rgya che rab zab chos dbyings rgya mtsho las: rin chen mchog brnyes bder gshegs padma'i zhal: gsung mchog rdo rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i gtso: rgyal ba 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'khor ba'i skyon bral padma dag pa'i sku: mtshan dpe rab rgyas nyi ma 'bum bas brjid: rin chen sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' mdzes: mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: ye shes dbyings nas thugs rje'i sprin bsdus shing: gsung dbyangs 'brug sgra yangs pas 'gro rnams la: bdud rtsi chos kyi char chen 'beb mdzad pa'i: mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: stong nyid snying rje dbyer med ro gcig pa: zhi ba spros med 'od gsal 'dus ma byas: mkha' ltar dag pa'i ye shes thugs mnga' ba: mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: bum bzang dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin gyi: rin chen lta bur dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung: kun gyi dpal mgon yon tan re ba skong: mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: 'jig rten gsum mgon 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu: sngon gyi thugs dam yal bar mi 'dor zhing: gang la ci 'dul phrin las thogs med pa'i: mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: tshe dang ye shes dbyings kyi rang bzhin las: 'gro kun 'chi med bde ba'i lam la bkod: sa bcu'i mgon po kun gyi mgon gyur pa: mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phyogs bcu'i khro bo kun gyi che btsan 'bar: bdud dang gshin rje kun gyi gshed gyur pa: rdo rje khro bos gdon rnams brlag par byed: khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can sdug bsngal mtshor: bying zhing rigs drug las la spyod pa rnams: 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral nas bde bar 'dren: 'khor ba dong sprugs thugs rje can la bstod: hūm̐: lha dang lha min mi yi gnas kun dang: dud 'gro yi dwags dmyal ba'i zhing rnams su: snying rje'i sku mnga' 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal skyob: rigs drug spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: gdug pa can la snying rjes rab khros pas: bdud bzhi dpung bcom dpa' bo rta mchog sku: gar gyi dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chos dbyings rnam dag dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum: sa gsum dkyil 'khor kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i: bde chen dag pa'i gnas su 'dren mdzad pa'i: lha mo rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: tshogs gnyis phul phyin yon tan rgya mtsho brnyes: 'gro kun dbul ba'i phongs pa bsal byed pa'i: rgyal ba rin chen mang po sku mchog che: rnam mang thos sras bu la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa gdul:

tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' che: grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig byed pa'i: gtum po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar bzhugs pa yi: dus gsum bder gshegs 'gro mgon phyogs bcu yi: rgyal ba sras bcas de dag thams cad la: sgo gsum dang bas btud de bstod par bgyi: hūm̐: dam tshig can gyi rgyal po chen po bzhi: sgo bzhi skyong zhing dgra bgegs tshar gcod byed: dpal mgon bdun cu gtsang ma ris kyi lha: 'khor dang bcas la mchod cing bstod par bya: zhes bstod par bya'o: bcu gcig pa 'dzab bzla ba ni: 'dzab dgongs: 'dzab dbyangs: mchod bstod las sbyor rim pa'o: 'di yi dgongs pa ni: sngon gu ru padma rgyal po me tog las sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe: ḍā ki gsang ba ye shes la ḍā ki 'bum phrag du ma bcas pa pad sdong la bskor nas: padma'i yan lag rlung gis bskyod pa'i rta la bskyon nas dgongs pa gsal gdab pa dang: bung bas me tog gi bcud len pa'i tshul gyis 'dzab bzlas pa dang: mtsho chen rlabs g.yos pa'i tshul gyis las la sbyar ba'o: dang po ni: hrī: bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje can rnams la: byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi: byang chub sems bskyed bdag gis bzung nas kyang: 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: skyabs sems: dgongs pa lhar gsal ba: hrī: stong nyid snying rje'i ngang las rang byung ba: ye shes 'od lnga 'bar ba'i gzhal yas dbus: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i sku: thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug gsal: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku bzhi lhun gyis grub: sku mdog dkar po gangs ri'i phung po 'dra: thal sbyar phreng ba padma skyil krung bzhugs: rgyan dang sprul pa 'gro ba'i 'dod dgur sgyur: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: spyi gtsug bla ma snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs: rta mgrin dbang chen thugs kar nyon mongs 'joms:

yi ge drug ma ye shes dbyings kyi yum: thabs dang shes rab sras dang sras mo gsal: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: phyogs dang phyogs mtshams mgon po tshe dpag med: mi g.yo dong sprugs rigs drug spyan ras gzigs: rta mgrin rig byed dzam la mgon por bcas: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha tshogs ma lus rnams: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: pad 'dab drug la rig sngags 'bru drug po: mu khyud ye shes rang mdangs kha dog lnga: gsol 'debs bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la: ye shes rnam pa lnga yi dbang skur cig: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: thams cad chos dbyings rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: ye shes lha tshogs 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs: phyi nang gsang ba'i phyag mchod gtor tshogs bzhes: dmigs med yongs sgrol 'gro don lhun rdzogs shog: ྈྈ de nas me tog bcud len gyi bzlas pa ni: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: bdag gi spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga nas: sku gsung thugs kyi snying po 'bru gsum gnas: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pa las: khams gsum yongs sgrol sku gsum thob par shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: thugs kyi padma 'dab drug lte ba la: yang snying srog gi sa bon yi ge hrī: 'od zer yar 'phros rgyal ba rgya mtsho mnyes: 'od zer mar 'phros 'khor ba dong sprugs shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: yang snying hrīḥlas yi ge drug gis bskor: 'od zer 'phros pas rigs drug gnas su phog: 'gro ba rigs drug sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad: nyon mongs drug sangs ye shes rgyas par shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: las sbyor lam khyer chu rlabs lta bu'i dbyangs ni: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: snang ba thams cad ye nas rang gi sems: sems nyid gang yang ma grub stong pa nyid: gnyis med spang blang med pa bde ba che: yid dpyod blo 'das dgongs pa shar bar shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: snang ba thams cad snang stong sangs rgyas sku:

sgra grags thams cad grags stong chos nyid gsung: dran rtog thams cad bde stong ye shes thugs: gnyis med zhi ba sangs rgyas thob par shog: ྈྈ ces mi tra snying thig 'jig rten dbang phyug gi mchod phreng bram ze'i lugs su bkod pa tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho zhes bya ba: padma rgyal pos sbyar ba rdzogs so: ghu hye: ྈྈ rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs mchod las shes so: tshogs mchod mi byed na rjes 'di yis bsdu ba'o: dang po bshags pa: gnyis pa bkra shis: gsum pa dal bsdu ba'o: dang po ni: oṃ: gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas: legs spyad 'di la nyes pa gang: thugs dang 'gal ba gang bgyis pa: 'gro mgon khyed la bzod par gsol: ces yig brgya: dbyangs gsal: rten 'brel snying po rnams brjod: gnyis pa bkra shis ni: oṃ: bkra shis dang po byang chub thugs bskyed pas: byang chub sems mchog chos dbyings mkha' ltar dag: kun khyab stong nyid bkra shis gang lags pa: bkra shis de yis sems can sangs rgyas shog: bkra shis gnyis pa sa bcu'i lam la gnas: thugs rje chen po'i snying rje nyi ma shar: theg pa mchog gi bkra shis gang lags pa: bkra shis de yis smon 'jug mthar phyin shog: bkra shis gsum pa gsang sngags chos sgra sgrog: theg chen sprin phung nam mkha'i khams kun khyab: bskyed rdzogs chos char bkra shis gang lags pa: bkra shis de yis smin grol mthar phyin shog: bkra shis bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi lam: phrin las rnam bzhi'i rtsi bcud rgyas pa yis: bsdu ba bzhi yi bkra shis gang lags pa: bkra shis de yis skyes bzhi grol bar shog: bkra shis lnga pa ye shes lnga yi 'od: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas 'bras bu mngon gyur pa'i: sku lnga lhun grub bkra shis gang lags pa: bkra shis de yis nyon mongs lnga grol shog: bkra shis drug pa yi ge 'bru drug shar: thugs rje drug gis 'gro don mthar phyin pas: rigs drug bde ba'i bkra shis gang lags pa:
bkra shis de yis 'khor ba dong sprugs shog:

ces bya'o: gsum pa dal bsdu zhing rgyun spyod bya ba ni: ho: chos dbyings mkha' la snying rje'i dkyil 'khor shar: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: 'gro don mthar phyin thig le gcig tu gyur: thig le mi dmigs mtshan ma bral bar bzhag: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra mu: lam khyer ni: āoṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: oṃ las phyi snod gzhal yas khang: ma las nang bcud lha yi tshogs: ṇi las sgra grags yi ge drug: pad las dran rtog phyag rgya che: me las phrin las 'gro don rdzogs: hūm̐ las chos kun rdzogs pa che: 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal du shar: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: sa ma ya: ྈྈྈ lha min ྈ nri'i rgya: ྈྈྈྈ yi rgya: narar rgya: bdag stag sham pas chu lug la 'dong chu nas gdan drangs pa'o// maṅga laṃ// //
